bulkImportSteps.title: Bulk upload from Excel
bulkImportSteps.intro: Import Products and Variants together with their packaging materials in one Excel file, then import Recipes and Ingredients (optional). Each file is fully validated and saved atomically. Configure images in the product editor. Complete recipes and packaging before quoting.
bulkImportSteps.requires1: Step 1 · Products, Variants and materials — requires active Categories, Subcategories, Clients and Presentations; existing packaging codes and groups when materials are included. Imported products are created as non-organic. The Organic column in older templates is ignored. Use individual creation or editing to register an organic product.
bulkImportSteps.requires2: Step 2 · Recipes — references each product through a variant SKU from step 1; requires Raw Materials in their catalog.
bulkImportSteps.requires3: Step 3 · Ingredients (optional) — references each product through a variant SKU from step 1; requires Ingredients in their catalog.

bulkImport.title: Bulk upload Recipes from Excel
bulkImport.description: Download the template, fill it in with each product's recipe (one row per raw material) and upload it. The products must already exist (step 1) and each raw material is looked up by its code. "Porcentaje" (percentage) is required on every row and the product's rows must total 100%. The whole file is validated first: if a single row has an error, no recipe is created. This importer only CREATES recipes: a product that already has one is rejected (edit it from its screen). Identify each product using "SKU de una variante del producto" (SKU of a product variant). Recipes and ingredients are shared by all its variants; using different SKUs of the same product does not allow duplicate rows.

bulkImport.title: Bulk upload product Ingredients from Excel
bulkImport.description: Optional. Download the template, fill it in with each product's added ingredients (one row per ingredient) and upload it. The products must already exist (step 1) and each ingredient is looked up by its code. "Gramos" (grams) are the grams in a "Peso de referencia (g)" (reference weight) presentation (e.g. 40 g in 2000 g) and can't exceed that weight. The whole file is validated first: if a single row has an error, nothing is created. This importer only CREATES: a product that already has ingredients is rejected (edit them from its screen). Identify each product using "SKU de una variante del producto" (SKU of a product variant). Recipes and ingredients are shared by all its variants; using different SKUs of the same product does not allow duplicate rows.

palletKit.title: Pallet kit
palletKit.hint: Pallet, corner boards and stretch film used on every pallet. They are added to every quote with their fixed quantity; materials are created in Packaging (generic pallet materials) and chosen here.
palletKit.complete: The kit is complete: it is added to every quote.
palletKit.incomplete: A type is not assigned: quoting is blocked until then.
palletKit.chosen: Several materials: the representative chooses one (never the quantity).
palletKit.noCandidates: No generic materials of this type available

rules.title: Pallet by client

rules.automatic: The pallet is assigned automatically for the client.

quoteReview.lineUnreadable: This line's breakdown could not be read.

list.title: Management reviews
list.description: Orders that representatives sent for review. Open one to check its costs, set the profit per pound and approve or reject it.

table.empty: There are no orders with this status.

detail.loadError: The review could not be loaded. Check the link or go back to the list.
detail.approvedDescription: An approved order cannot change. The representative sees the final price only once you authorize sending the quote.
detail.rejectedDescription: The representative sees the rejection and its reason. Nothing was sent to the client and the order is closed.

profit.title: Profit per pound
profit.description: Enter the amount you want to earn per net pound. It applies equally to every product based on its pounds.
profit.approveHint: First calculate the final price with the amount you want to approve. Rejecting does not need it.

delivery.label: Commercial quote
delivery.pdfError: The quote PDF could not be generated. Try again.

status.failed: Could not be sent. You can retry.

decision.noticeFailed: The decision was saved, but the representative could not be notified by email.

deliveryModal.approveDescription: Choose how to distribute the quote with the final price. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
deliveryModal.sendDescription: Choose who receives the approved quote. It is sent only once.

none.title: Approve without sending
none.description: The final price is saved. The representative gets a notice without prices or PDF.

representative.title: Send to the representative
representative.description: The PDF with the final price goes only to the representative's email. The client does not receive it.

representative_and_client.title: Send to the representative, copying the client
representative_and_client.description: The PDF with the final price goes to the representative, copying the client's email.

deliveryModal.clientEmailSaved: You can change it: the email you confirm is kept on this order.
deliveryModal.clientEmailNew: The order has no client email. Enter it to copy them: it is kept on this order and on the client's record if they had none.

rejectModal.title: Reject quote
rejectModal.description: The representative will get a notice with the reason. Nothing is sent to the client and the order is closed.
rejectModal.placeholder: E.g.: we do not have the requested product, we cannot meet the delivery, or the profitability is not enough.
